blocks.title: Safety reading
blocks.content:
Under the Wound Dressing profile, this construct clears every assessed gate but sits close to one.
Toxicity (ToxinPred3) reports 0.36 against a threshold of 0.38 from a platform-wide constant, which is at or below the limit. The value sits within ten percent of the threshold.
Haemolysis (HemoPI2) reports 0.191941 against a threshold of 0.55 from the predictor's own cut-off, which is at or below the limit.
Immunogenicity (MHC-I) has no predictor value (screening threshold 0.35), so it is reported as not assessed rather than as a pass. The pipeline's rule is that an unassessed metric does not eliminate a candidate.
Soft signals, which do not veto: B-cell epitope (soft) 0.260472 (threshold 0.1512).
